Defeat line: Did you take it easy on me by any chance?
Post-battle line: Drifting along with the waves… I love it! Why don't you give it a try?

Intro line: Which do you prefer, fishing in the sea or a stream?
Defeat line: Like in deep-sea fishing, I lost spectacularly!
Post-battle line: Fishing is the greatest whether it's in the sea or a stream. You agree with me, right?
Rebattle line: I caught a bunch of POKéMON fishing. I'll show you an impressive battle!

Intro line: What do people do if they need to go to a washroom? / What if my ROD hooks a big one while I'm in the washroom? I just can't go…
Defeat line: I lost because I'm trying to not go to the washroom…
Post-battle line: Oh, no! I've got this feeling I'll hook a big one!

Defeat line: Oh, darn. I've gone and lost.

Intro line: Hahahaha! How about we have a battle? You and me! Hahahaha!
Defeat line: I lost! Hahahaha!
Post-battle line: Hahahahaha! Something flew up my nose! Hahahaha-hatchoo!

Intro line: My legs are solid from pounding up and down the mountains. / They're not going to buckle easily, friend!
Defeat line: Ouch! My legs cramped up!
Post-battle line: Try hiking, and I mean really pounding, on these mountain trails with a heavy pack weighing dozens of pounds. / That, my friend, will get your body into serious shape.
Rebattle line: I've been keeping fit by hiking. Power, I have in spades!

Intro line: I'm strong. I won't cry if I lose.
Defeat line: Waaaah!
Post-battle line: I'm not crying because I miss my mommy! Snivel…

Intro line: When you're out on a picnic, why, you simply have to sing! Come on, sing with me!
Defeat line: Oh, you're so strong!
Post-battle line: It doesn't matter if you're good or bad at singing or POKéMON. / If you have the most fun, you win!

Intro line: I caught hot POKéMON in FIERY PATH! Take a look!
Defeat line: What a bumpy ride that was!
Post-battle line: I like the way you battle. It has a certain flair to it.

Intro line: Oh, aren't you an adorable TRAINER! Please, I need a romantic battle! I'm somewhat decent!
Defeat line: Oh, how strong you are! You've given me quite a shock!
Post-battle line: Are you busy right now? I was thinking that maybe we can have a rematch right now… But it's all right if you're busy.

Intro line: When TEAM MAGMA has roll call, we get important guarding assignments in the order that we line up. / That's why I'm stuck off in this corner. I'm always late to roll call!
Defeat line: I'm always late for training sessions, too! / I hate to say it, but I'm wimpy…
Post-battle line: Okay, I'll try to put a little more effort into things from now on…

Intro line: Our leader told us to dig into MT. CHIMNEY, so we dug and dug. / And in the course of digging, we came across something that blew our minds! / What did we find? / Fuhahaha! I'll tell you if you beat me!
Defeat line: Arrgh! Taken down!
Post-battle line: I won't tell you after all. You'll find out when you get there! / It'd be better if you saved surprises to the end, don't you think?

Intro line: If you want to know the secret about our HIDEOUT, you have me to beat!
Defeat line: I can't win at all…
Post-battle line: Our HIDEOUT's secret? / Well, let's just say… There's a submarine at the far end! / But, by now… Kekekeke…

Intro line: Fuel supply loaded A-OK! In-cruise snacks loaded A-OK! / Nothing left to do but KO a pesky meddler!
Defeat line: I took a serious licking!
Post-battle line: Humph! This was supposed to happen! / My mission was to just hold you up!

Intro line: Yawn… Keeping watch over the HIDEOUT bores me. I'll take you on.
Defeat line: Yawn… Oh, I lost…
Post-battle line: If you scurry too much, other TEAM AQUA members might get you.

Intro line: Hey! You there! / Which do you think is cooler? TEAM AQUA's uniform or TEAM MAGMA's?
Defeat line: I lost in a cool way…
Post-battle line: If you have a cool uniform, you look good even in a loss, don't you think?

Defeat line: What?! I lost to a mere child like you?!
Post-battle line: ARCHIE: Fufufu… / I commend you. I must recognize that you are truly gifted. / But! I have this in my possession! / With this RED ORB, I can make KYOGRE…

Intro line: DAN: While searching for treasures, we discovered a TRAINER!
Defeat line: DAN: We couldn't win even though we worked together…
Post-battle line: DAN: We can't find any treasures… I wonder if someone got them already?
Rebattle line: DAN: We've been searching for treasures all this time. / Our POKéMON have grown stronger, too. Let us show you, okay?

Intro line: I'm not good at swimming, but I am good at battles!
Defeat line: Oops. That didn't go very well.
Post-battle line: Walking around barefoot in this ship is kind of gross.

Intro line: Strength and compassion… Those are a TRAINER's treasures!
Defeat line: Ah, there is something about you that sparkles.
Post-battle line: In a cabin somewhere on board, I saw something sparkle.

Intro line: I've given up on my plans to convert the city, I have. / And so, I put my time into making door traps in my GYM. / Oh? Now, what are you doing here? / What's that? You say you've gotten past all my rigged doors? / Wahahahah! Now, that is amusing! / Then, I, WATTSON, the LEADER of MAUVILLE GYM, shall electrify you!
Defeat line: Wahahahah! Fine, I lost! / You ended up giving me a thrill! Take this BADGE!
Post-battle line: I swell with optimism, seeing a promising young TRAINER like you!
Rebattle line: WATTSON: Ah-ha! Here at last! I know what you want. You want to battle my POKéMON! / Wahahahaha! / I'll make sparks fly from you! Don't say I didn't warn you!

Intro line: My electric soul, it'll shatter your dreams whole, whoa-yeahah!
Defeat line: That was plugged in, amped up, over-driven electric, man!
Post-battle line: POKéMON and rock, it's all about heart, whoa-yeah!

Intro line: I trained under WATTSON! There ain't no way I'll lose easily!
Defeat line: Unplugged and turned off…
Post-battle line: WATTSON, our GYM LEADER, has been around for a long, long time. / He was battling even before your daddy was born, that tough coot.

Intro line: This GYM's got puzzles! Isn't it fun?
Defeat line: It's no fun to lose…
Post-battle line: WATTSON says he likes setting up little traps with switches.

Intro line: With my charm and my POKéMON's moves, you'll be shocked!
Defeat line: I'm shocked by your power!
Post-battle line: I've heard that MAUVILLE was founded by WATTSON. / He was a TRAINER long before we became TRAINERS. He must know all sorts of things!

Intro line: I love shiny things!
Defeat line: Oh… My eyes are frazzled…
Post-battle line: MAUVILLE GYM's WATTSON has a shiny forehead. It makes me happy!

Intro line: I'll hack and slash my way to victory with the CUT we just learned!
Defeat line: Why are you so serious?
Post-battle line: I never get tired of hacking and slashing!

Intro line: I wandered into this weird house by accident…
Defeat line: And now I've lost…
Post-battle line: I lost my way, I lost a battle, and I'm now even more lost… I can't get out…

Intro line: Just who is the TRICK MASTER?
Defeat line: I lost while I was lost in thought!
Post-battle line: You're strong! Just who are you?

Intro line: I don't have a bone to pick with you. I'm just following orders!
Defeat line: I may have lost, but…
Post-battle line: We dug up something beyond belief! And, we got the BLUE ORB! / All that's left is for our leader to… Fufufu… Fwahahaha!

Intro line: I can't stand heat. Maybe I should've joined TEAM AQUA instead…
Defeat line: Yeah, I really may not be right for TEAM MAGMA…
Post-battle line: Don't you get lonely for the sea being in a place like this?

Intro line: You can hear tremors here sometimes. / Could it be the volcano rattling? Or is it GROU… / Whoops! No, no, never mind!
Defeat line: You're a fiery battler. Just like a volcano!
Post-battle line: You just happened to win this time, but that doesn't matter. / TEAM MAGMA's goal is about to be reached!

Intro line: One of our guys was freaking out that he lost his MAGMA EMBLEM… / Wait a minute! Was it you who found it?
Defeat line: I'm having trouble believing this…
Post-battle line: I'm getting this feeling that our plan is going to end in failure…

Intro line: Hey, are you lost at sea? / If you can beat my POKéMON, I can serve as your pilot.
Defeat line: I lost my bearings in battle!
Post-battle line: Many people lose their bearings at sea. / If you're that sort, you should refer to the POKéNAV's MAP.

Intro line: Hm! You're riding a POKéMON instead of swimming yourself… / I am envious!
Defeat line: Oh! I can't…
Post-battle line: I'm getting chilled… I've been in the water too long… / I wish I could ride a POKéMON like you…

Intro line: If you just float in the sea like this, POKéMON come around to play.
Defeat line: Oh, darn. I've gone and lost.
Post-battle line: While swimming, I noticed that some POKéMON attack, and some just watch. / I guess POKéMON have personalities of their own.
Rebattle line: If you just float in the sea like this, TRAINERS challenge you!

Intro line: I'm growing bored of swimming… How about a battle?
Defeat line: I had no idea that you were this strong!
Post-battle line: All the effort you put in must have made you this strong.

Intro line: Fufufufu… I dive deep underwater to go deep under cover. Plumbing the depths is where I excel!
Defeat line: Glub, glub, glub… I'm sinking…
Post-battle line: I have it on good authority that there's a DIVE spot around here. / It gives me the urge to go deep again…

Intro line: LILA: Sigh… / Here I am in the sea, but who's with me? My little brother! / Let's battle so I won't have to dwell on that!
Defeat line: LILA: ROY! It's your fault we lost! You're in for it later!
Post-battle line: LILA: Sigh… / If only it wasn't my little brother next to me, but a nice boyfriend…
Rebattle line: LILA: Sigh… / Here I am in the sea, but who's with me? My little brother! / Oh, hi, it's been a while. Let's battle so I won't have to dwell on things!

Intro line: Here I am swimming by my lonesome on this wide, beautiful sea. / There's no other word for it. This is pathetic!
Defeat line: I'm feeling blue. Blue as the sky…
Post-battle line: I should chat up lady SWIMMERS and invite them on a long swim.

Intro line: I'm not going to lose to some surfer TRAINER.
Defeat line: I've only got sweat in my eyes! I am not crying!
Post-battle line: You can find pretty colored shards of things around here.

Intro line: I am WINONA. I am the LEADER of the FORTREE POKéMON GYM. / I have become one with BIRD POKéMON and have soared the skies… / However grueling the battle, we have triumphed with grace… / Witness the elegant choreography of BIRD POKéMON and I!
Defeat line: Never before have I seen a TRAINER command POKéMON with more grace than I… / In recognition of your prowess, I present to you this GYM BADGE.
Post-battle line: Though I fell to you, I will remain devoted to BIRD POKéMON.
Rebattle line: WINONA: We humans can never escape gravity's pull on the ground. / But by striving for excellence, we have the power to soar! / You have scaled the pinnacle as the reigning CHAMPION. / Please, allow me to see your power at full flight!

Intro line: Behold the elegant battle style of BIRD POKéMON!
Defeat line: You… You're strong…
Post-battle line: A TRAINER has to be smart to keep up with unexpected turns of events. / Do you have the smarts to get to our LEADER?

Intro line: The lovers of BIRD POKéMON aspire to join this GYM. / As a member of the FORTREE GYM, I'm not allowed to lose!
Defeat line: It was too much of a load for me to bear…
Post-battle line: The world is huge, and there are countless tough TRAINERS. / I'm going to keep training and make myself even stronger.

Intro line: There's no need for WINONA, our GYM LEADER, to deal with you! / I'm plenty good enough for you!
Defeat line: WINONA, I… I lost!
Post-battle line: WINONA is cute and she's strong. She's the ultimate LEADER! / Blush…

Intro line: WINONA taught me personally! You can't beat me easily!
Defeat line: I was beaten…
Post-battle line: Thanks to WINONA, the people of FORTREE can live without fear.

Intro line: When WINONA takes to battle, her face shines with beautiful determination… / I'm not letting you witness that lovely sight!
Defeat line: Urk! I couldn't stop you.
Post-battle line: You'd better watch it! Don't get distracted staring at WINONA or you'll go crashing down in a heap!

Intro line: You'd better know that there are all sorts of FLYING-type POKéMON. / You do know that, right?
Defeat line: You seem to know your stuff!
Post-battle line: Sure, you beat me all right. But you'd better watch it! Our LEADER WINONA's POKéMON are all business.

Intro line: The aroma of flowers has a magical power. It cleanses us body and soul.
Defeat line: Oh, dear me. I seem to have lost.
Post-battle line: Flowers, POKéMON… I love whatever smells nice. / Stinky things… I'll pass.
Rebattle line: Were you drawn here by the sweet aroma?

Intro line: I'm a FISHERMAN, but also a TRAINER. I'm raising the POKéMON I caught.
Defeat line: I thought I was doing okay in my training…
Post-battle line: I couldn't win by training POKéMON while I fished… / Was I doing things in half measures?

Intro line: For FISHERMEN, equipment is the key. / But for TRAINERS, the key ingredients are POKéMON and heart, of course!
Defeat line: I was beaten in heart?
Post-battle line: Come to think of it, fishing is a battle between a FISHERMAN and a POKéMON.

Intro line: Let my melody rock your soul!
Defeat line: La-lalala…
Post-battle line: An electric guitar doesn't always have to be noisy… / It can be strummed to squeeze out this heart-stirring melody…
Rebattle line: A melody from my POKéMON and me… Let us deliver it to your soul.

Intro line: BIRD POKéMON that FLY elegantly in the sky… They're the best!
Defeat line: Urgh… I crashed…
Post-battle line: You've got great POKéMON. I'll have to train mine better.

Intro line: Take flight! My BIRD POKéMON!
Defeat line: They did take flight…
Post-battle line: If they'd get stronger, they'd be able to fly more freely…

Intro line: Go, go, go! POKéMON 1, 2, and 3!
Defeat line: Come in, POKéMON! Are you okay? POKéMON 1, 2, and 3?!
Post-battle line: Isn't it cool that I have a POKéMON battle team? / You can copy me--I don't mind!

Intro line: Arrrgh! I'm fed up and dog-tired of cleaning this huge place! / Let's have a quick battle!
Defeat line: Little bro, I lost!
Post-battle line: We're the CLEANUP BROTHERS! / The old one dumps the detergent, and the young one does the scrubbing!

Intro line: This is the bottom of the ship's hull. There's plenty of room. It'll be alright for a POKéMON battle.
Defeat line: Big bro, I lost!
Post-battle line: We're the CLEANUP BROTHERS! / The old one dumps the detergent, and the young one does the scrubbing!

Defeat line: Superb, it should be said.

Intro line: The BOSS got interested in the research they have going here, so he sent us out. / You quit meddling!
Defeat line: Blast it… Blasted by a kid…
Post-battle line: Our BOSS knows everything. / But I'm just a GRUNT. What would I know about what he's thinking?

Intro line: Huh? What's a kid doing here?
Defeat line: Huh? I lost?!
Post-battle line: Oh, no… I'll catch an earful for losing to a kid… / I should just take a nap in the bed…

Intro line: Hiyah! Look at my chiseled abs! This is what you call “cut”!
Defeat line: Aiyah! Flubbed out!
Post-battle line: Hiyah! / My sculpted abs have nothing to do with POKéMON battles!

Intro line: Are you properly protected against the sun?
Defeat line: Ouch, ouch, ouch!
Post-battle line: Cheeks are the most prone to burning!

Intro line: I've laid anchor in ports around the world, but SLATEPORT's the best.
Defeat line: You're the best!
Post-battle line: In the best port was the best TRAINER…

Intro line: Urrrrppp… Battle? With me?
Defeat line: Urp… Ooooooohhhhhh… Urrrrpppp…
Post-battle line: I'm usually stronger than this! I'm just seasick as a dog! / I'm a SAILOR, but…

Intro line: I'm thirsty… I could go for a SODA POP at the SEASHORE HOUSE…
Defeat line: Groan…
Post-battle line: I'm getting famished… My inner tube looks like a giant doughnut…
Rebattle line: I'm hungry, but I've got enough pep in me for a battle!

Intro line: Doesn't a beach umbrella look like a giant flower?
Defeat line: Mommy!
Post-battle line: If you look at the beach from the sky, it looks like a big flower garden!
Rebattle line: I'm not losing to you again! That's why I have my inner tube!

Intro line: I can't swim without my inner tube, but I won't lose at POKéMON!
Defeat line: Did I lose because I have an inner tube?
Post-battle line: My inner tube is a fashion item. I can't be seen without it.

Intro line: Hi, big TRAINER. Will you battle with me?
Defeat line: Oh, you're strong.
Post-battle line: How did you get to be so strong?

Intro line: Wahahah! This dude's going to catch himself a big one!
Defeat line: This dude just lost one…
Post-battle line: This dude thinks you're a big one. No, you're a big-one-to-be!

Intro line: PAUL: Well, this is a mood-breaker. / I wish you wouldn't disturb our precious time together.
Defeat line: PAUL: Well, I give up.
Post-battle line: PAUL: Well, don't tell anyone that we're here. This is just our private world of two!

Intro line: Tadaah! See? My inner tube's round!
Defeat line: Oh, oh! Too bad!
Post-battle line: After I showed you my round inner tube, too…

Intro line: I can't swim, so I'm pretending to swim.
Defeat line: I thought so! I didn't think we could win.
Post-battle line: When I learn how to swim, I think my POKéMON will become tougher.

Intro line: For a guy as macho as me, this kind of POKéMON is the perfect match!
Defeat line: I'm cool even in defeat, hey?
Post-battle line: For a guy as macho as me, a port is the perfect setting! / I guess I'll head for SLATEPORT.

Intro line: When I'm here… A curious power flows into me…
Defeat line: The power is ebbing away…
Post-battle line: Perhaps the power is from the spirits of POKéMON in fitful sleep here…
Rebattle line: Behind you… What is it…

Intro line: Have you lost your bearings? Have no fear for I am here!
Defeat line: Weren't you lost?
Post-battle line: I had this feeling that a lost TRAINER would be panicked and easy to beat. / It's dirty and I won't try it again…

Intro line: I trained together with my whole family, every one of us! I'm not losing to anyone!
Defeat line: Better than my family?! Is that possible?!
Post-battle line: I was better than everyone in my family. I've never lost before… / I've lost my confidence… Maybe I'll go home…

Intro line: I'd heard that there was a tough little kid around. Do they mean you?
Defeat line: The little shrimp is tough!
Post-battle line: The rumors I heard, that tough little kid is from PETALBURG CITY.

Intro line: You must be getting a little tired.
Defeat line: No signs of tiring at all!
Post-battle line: VICTORY ROAD and the POKéMON LEAGUE are long and grueling challenges. Beware of fatigue!

Intro line: You shouldn't get complacent just because you have a lot of GYM BADGES. / There's always going to be someone who's better than you!
Defeat line: You're better than me!
Post-battle line: Gaze on your collected BADGES and remember the TRAINERS you've faced.

Intro line: I've come this far, but the tension's giving me awful stomach pain…
Defeat line: Ooh… It hurts…
Post-battle line: I can't help getting all tense knowing that I'm nearing the POKéMON LEAGUE. / It's all I can do to feign calm.

Intro line: The elite among the elite gather in this cave. / How are you finding it?
Defeat line: Not rattled in the least bit!
Post-battle line: You do have guts! I like that! Keep it going!

Defeat line: I lost! But!
Post-battle line: It's too soon to be relieved! I'm up next!

Defeat line: I lost, too! But!
Post-battle line: I bet you want to take a break. But I'm not about to let you do that!

Defeat line: We should've taken a break… That's what we should've done…

Intro line: Swimming is a full-body workout! You will get fit!
Defeat line: I admit it! You win!
Post-battle line: Thanks to my daily swimming routine… Look! Feast your eyes on this physique!

Intro line: This towering white mountain of rock is SOOTOPOLIS CITY.
Defeat line: I was done in?
Post-battle line: I can't find the entrance to SOOTOPOLIS. Where could it be?

Intro line: Ufufufufu! I'm a mermaid!
Defeat line: My fantasy burst as if it were a bubble! Blub, blub, blub…
Post-battle line: You thrashed me… I want to disappear in a wave of despair…

Intro line: Hello, kiddo! Want a battle with me?
Defeat line: Oh, noooooh!
Post-battle line: I love frolicking with POKéMON in the sea like this!

Intro line: I couldn't even swim last year, but now I'm a decent SWIMMER. / I think I'm capable of anything now.
Defeat line: Sheesh, getting greedy didn't do a thing for me.
Post-battle line: If you practice at something, you will get better at it. / You're young--don't be afraid to try all sorts of things!

Intro line: If seawater gets up your nose, doesn't it feel terrible?
Defeat line: Ack! Why, you… Glub!
Post-battle line: Ooh, I choked on some water! It's bitter! It's salty!!

Intro line: I'm throwing my whole heart into this!
Defeat line: You had more heart!
Post-battle line: I need to cool down now… I think I'll go for a dive.

Intro line: Check out this sculpted body! I'm more cut than a BLACK BELT!
Defeat line: Whoops! Too strong! Not bad! Not bad at all!
Post-battle line: Losing to you stimulated my senses! I'll train myself and POKéMON harder!
Rebattle line: Check out this beautiful body! I'm more shapely than a SWIMMER!

Intro line: Welcome… No, wait. / Puny TRAINER, how good to see you've made it here! / I have been entrusted with the… No, wait. / I am FLANNERY, and I'm the GYM LEADER here! / Uh… Dare not underestimate me, though I have been LEADER only a short time! / With skills inherited from my grand- father, I shall, uh…demonstrate the hot moves we have honed on this land!
Defeat line: Oh… I guess I was trying too hard… / I… I've only recently become a GYM LEADER. / I tried too hard to be someone I'm not. / I have to do things my natural way. If I don't, my POKéMON will be confused. / Thanks for teaching me that. For that, you deserve this.
Post-battle line: Your power reminds me of someone… / Oh! I know! You battle like NORMAN, the GYM LEADER of PETALBURG.
Rebattle line: FLANNERY: Losing a battle isn't going to deflate me. / I love POKéMON. I love to battle. And… I love this GYM! / Let's exchange superhot moves in another battle!

Intro line: Owowowowow! Yikes, it's hot!
Defeat line: I'm blinded by sweat in my eyes…

Intro line: I'm trying to relieve my stress. Don't come along and stress me out!
Defeat line: I hope FLANNERY flames you good!
Post-battle line: Haaah… Whew… / If you spend too much time buried in hot sand, it tuckers you out…

Intro line: You must be getting tired by now. You'd like to rest in the hot sand, wouldn't you? / But you should know that maintaining your willpower is an important ability for all TRAINERS.
Defeat line: Play with fire, and be burned…
Post-battle line: Your skill is real… But our LEADER FLANNERY is strong. / If you don't watch yourself, you'll be burned seriously.

Intro line: Um… Okay, I'll battle with you.
Defeat line: Oh, but you're too strong.
Post-battle line: I'm going to be a pretty and strong TRAINER just like FLANNERY.

Intro line: Can your POKéMON withstand 392-degree heat?
Defeat line: It didn't burn hotly enough…
Post-battle line: The temperature of magma is 392 degrees. / Your POKéMON beat me, so they should easily survive in magma.

Intro line: Come on, get with it! Let's go before my feelings cool!
Defeat line: It's so hot, and yet my heart is clutched by ice…
Post-battle line: The way the battling spirit burns within you, you may stand a chance against our LEADER.

Intro line: See how the flames blaze wildly? They flare in anticipation of my win!
Defeat line: Something didn't go right.
Post-battle line: Well, so what? I say so what? I can walk on hot coals barefoot! / …Don't even think about trying it!

Intro line: As much as I love mountains, I especially love volcanoes.
Defeat line: Well, it seems to me I lost without ever being in control.
Post-battle line: I stay here because I became a fan of FLANNERY's power. / Hehehehe.

Intro line: The TRICK MASTER always vanishes like smoke. How does he do it?
Defeat line: Aiyeeeh! You're much too strong! How do you do it?
Post-battle line: I wish I could appear and disappear as if I were smoke, too.

Intro line: Going around the same spot… It begets ill fortune…
Defeat line: Defeated! It's a bad sign…
Post-battle line: I've circled the same spot over ten times now… It's ill fortune…

Intro line: Whoever wins will get through here first. That's the feeling I get.
Defeat line: Oh! Well, go ahead, then!
Post-battle line: You're solving all the puzzles in the TRICK HOUSE. That's the feeling I get.

Intro line: Nufufufu, here at last! Let's get right with it!
Defeat line: You're so casual about winning!
Post-battle line: Humph! I'm not upset! Not me!

Intro line: I ever so closely watched you coming!
Defeat line: This outcome I didn't see coming…
Post-battle line: Well, anyway, we both picked a weird place to get acquainted. / As one weirdo to another, let's do our best!

Intro line: It's awfully cramped in here…
Defeat line: Oh, yes, strong you are.
Post-battle line: I was hoping to switch places with you when I beat you, but…

Defeat line: Urrrgh… / I should've ducked into our HIDEOUT right away…

Intro line: MT. CHIMNEY's JAGGED PASS… / Now this is what I've always wanted in a mountain. / This jagged bumpiness… It rocks my soul!
Defeat line: Losing left me bitter!
Post-battle line: Yes, I did lose at POKéMON… / But, when it comes to the love of the mountains, I have you beat!

Intro line: This place isn't your casual hike. It's not suited for a picnic.

Intro line: Ahah! An intruder!
Defeat line: Graaah!

Post-battle line: Hehehe! / Our BOSS has already gone on his way to some cave under the sea! / If you're going to give chase, you'd better search the big, wide sea beyond LILYCOVE. / But will you find it then? Hehehe!

Defeat line: Tired of waiting… Lost and dazed…
Post-battle line: BOSS… Is this good enough?

Defeat line: What's wrong with you? You're not tired at all!
Post-battle line: That reminds me… I can't remember where I put the MASTER BALL. / If I fail to guard it, our BOSS will chew me out…

Defeat line: I was too occupied thinking about the warp panels…
Post-battle line: I'll have to learn about how I can battle more effectively…

Intro line: Listen, could I get you to battle the POKéMON I'm raising?
Defeat line: You've raised yours superbly…
Post-battle line: POKéMON isn't all about power. / Polishing a unique aspect of one's character is another way of enjoying POKéMON.

Post-battle line: Try raising POKéMON with more attention to their character traits.

Defeat line: I ran out of energy!

Intro line: Once a BUG CATCHER! And now a BUG MANIAC! / But my love for POKéMON remains unchanged!
Defeat line: My ineptitude also remains unchanged…
Post-battle line: All I did was follow my heart, and now they call me a BUG MANIAC… / Still, I am an expert on BUG POKéMON, so it's only natural that they call me a BUG MANIAC.

Intro line: ANNA: I'm with my pretty junior student partner. I have to do good!
Defeat line: ANNA: I'm with my pretty junior student partner! Let me win!
Post-battle line: ANNA: Your POKéMON have some good combinations. / I'd say you're second only to us!
Rebattle line: ANNA: I can't keep losing in front of my junior partner, right?

Intro line: Isn't it nice? To battle while looking at pretty flowers?
Defeat line: Oh, that's quite impressive!
Post-battle line: It feels wonderful to go for a jog while looking at flowers.

Intro line: Let me demonstrate the power hidden within a PSYCHIC POKéMON!
Defeat line: Astonishing!
Post-battle line: PSYCHIC POKéMON are complex. You should try catching some.

Intro line: Concentrate on getting the win. That's how I battle!
Defeat line: I don't waste any time being angry over a loss--I would rather train.
Post-battle line: I think that if you worry about losing, you're more likely to lose.

Intro line: Did the currents carry you here, too? This must have been fated. Let's battle!
Defeat line: Strong! Too much so!
Post-battle line: It's just my luck that a tough TRAINER like you would drift here… I must be cursed…

Intro line: I've led a life of woe and misery… I've been cast away, and this is where I've drifted…
Defeat line: Another loss…
Post-battle line: A life adrift… I don't want it anymore!

Intro line: Welcome! I've been expecting you!
Defeat line: No! Please!
Post-battle line: A strong child TRAINER… That's so annoying!

Intro line: I want to win like everyone else, but I won't raise POKéMON like everyone else.
Defeat line: Darn it! My way is still too slack!
Post-battle line: It's way more fun to do things the way I want than to be like everybody else. I mean, that's obvious!

Intro line: I came all the way out here with my BIRD POKéMON.
Defeat line: You… You're stunningly cool!
Post-battle line: I'd like to go back to FORTREE, but I've grown to like this place, too.

Intro line: I must have battled thousands of times. I've lost count.
Defeat line: I may have lost thousands of times, but a loss still stings.
Post-battle line: Keep at this, youngster. So you can become like my husband and me.

Intro line: Young people are too happy to go with the flow. They're without direction.
Defeat line: You have a firm sense of purpose.
Post-battle line: Don't let others lead you astray. Don't lose direction as you grow older.

Defeat line: … / I… I can't… / I can't believe it. {PLAYER}… / I lost to {PLAYER}? / But, rules are rules! Here, take this.

Isn't that right, {PLAYER}?

Defeat line: That was a magnificent battle!

Defeat line: I couldn't confuse your team enough… You share a strong bond together.
Post-battle line: The next room is the STRENGTH ROOM. Can you withstand brute force?

Defeat line: I couldn't restore HP enough… What ATTACK power…

Intro line: I'm not going to take it easy just because you're our LEADER's kid. / I'll show you how horrid it is for a POKéMON to take a critical hit!
Defeat line: Your power… You're the real deal.
Post-battle line: Your father really is strong. He's a TRAINER worth my respect. / And, I sense the same glow coming from you as your father. / I hope that you'll stage a terrific battle with your father!

Intro line: Giggle… This is the ACCURACY ROOM. / It's pretty nasty when every attack lands without fail.
Defeat line: You were a cut above me…
Post-battle line: There are some even stronger TRAINERS waiting for you. / The left is the DEFENSE ROOM, and the right is the RECOVERY ROOM. / Your POKéMON's ATTACK power will be on trial either way.

Intro line: The higher the DEFENSE, the more reckless I can be in attack.
Defeat line: Our defenses weren't enough…

Intro line: Our GYM LEADER told us to go all out and beat you. / Even if you happen to be the LEADER's kid!
Defeat line: But… I went all out!
Post-battle line: The way you use your POKéMON… It's like your father's style. / Go on through! The GYM LEADER, your father, is waiting!

Defeat line: I'm getting heat exhaustion…
Post-battle line: Do you think it's odd that we're wearing hoods in this magma-filled volcano?

Intro line: We joined so we can help our leader achieve his fantastic vision. / I don't care if you're with TEAM AQUA or if you're just some kid passing by. / No one interferes with us and gets away with it!
Defeat line: Oh, no! You're not to be trusted at all!
Post-battle line: Listen to me. TEAM MAGMA is right! / Don't listen to TEAM AQUA. Don't believe their lies!

Intro line: Will you play with my delightfully pretty POKéMON?
Defeat line: This isn't what I meant!

Post-battle line: I would like to circle the globe once again with my POKéMON.
Rebattle line: With my POKéMON, I have traveled to the world's four corners. / You might say I have some confidence in my abilities.

Intro line: There are powers beyond our understanding in the world…
Defeat line: I have lost…
Post-battle line: MT. PYRE… There is a mysterious power at work there…

Intro line: KATE: Together, we're fearless! We'll demonstrate how tough we are!
Defeat line: KATE: I blew it in front of my junior student partner…
Post-battle line: KATE: When someone's relying on me, I get this urge to look cool in front of them…

Intro line: Stop! Have a good look at my precious POKéMON!

Intro line: There's nothing I love more than checking out other people's POKéMON!

Post-battle line: They're great, your POKéMON! How do you raise them?

Intro line: I want everybody to see the POKéMON I've raised!
Defeat line: Wow! Spectacular!

Defeat line: Oh, now what happened here?

Post-battle line: I didn't expect to lose this easily… I'll win next time!

Defeat line: Yodelayhihoo!
Post-battle line: When I was a wee tyke, I believed there was someone copying me and shouting back, “Yodelayhihoo.”

Defeat line: Way too strong!

Defeat line: What was that about? Did mine lose in size?
Post-battle line: Okay! I'll just fish me a bigger one!

Defeat line: I surrender!

Post-battle line: WALLY: I couldn't beat you today, {PLAYER}, but one of these days, I'll catch up to you!

Rebattle line: WALLY: Hi! {PLAYER}! / I've gotten stronger since that last time! I wanted to show you, {PLAYER}! / Okay… Here I come!

Defeat line: My dream ends here again…

Defeat line: Your battle style is fantastic…
Post-battle line: You seem to have the potential for becoming the CHAMPION.

Defeat line: This is a disgrace…

Defeat line: Hehehe… / Even though I've lost, if our leader awakens that thing…
Post-battle line: BOSS, hurry! Give it the METEORITE's energy! / Hehehe…

Defeat line: Oh, my goodness. Now, aren't you something!

Defeat line: Ooh, that was a scorching-hot match!
Post-battle line: The heat of MT. CHIMNEY warms me up, baby!

Post-battle line: Our boat drifted out to sea. / My buddy's a timid fellow, so I'm worried about him.

Intro line: My POKéMON can't be taken down easily!
Defeat line: You're kidding! Explain how I lost!
Post-battle line: Haha! You won, all right! / I'll work my way back up by taking on TRAINERS I happen to meet!

Intro line: Can your POKéMON dodge our lightning-quick attacks?
Defeat line: I never knew such a technique existed! You've defeated us thoroughly.
Post-battle line: I haven't lost my passion for speed. I will try harder.

Intro line: O-our boat! The tide carried it away!
Defeat line: Awawawawah! Please, stop! Please!
Post-battle line: If we can't SURF, how are we supposed to get home? / Actually, I know a fainted POKéMON can still SURF, but it feels wrong.
WALLY: UNCLE… I'll go back to VERDANTURF…

Intro line: Can you guess why it's so cool around here?
Defeat line: Peeuuw! That stinks!
Post-battle line: The volcanic ash blocks the sun, so it doesn't get very warm. / That's good for me--I can't stand heat!

Intro line: The volcano's eruption is proof that the earth is alive.
Defeat line: You're some kind of strong!
Post-battle line: Ouch! Owww! I can't see! I got ashes in my eyelashes! / Get it? Ashes and eyelashes? / Okay, that was bad, sorry…

Intro line: I use this parasol to ward off this filthy, yucky volcanic ash from my dear NUMEL.
Defeat line: Huff, huff… I am exhausted…
Post-battle line: You're very good at this. I must say I'm impressed!
Rebattle line: Oh, hello, hasn't it been a while? May I invite you to battle?

Intro line: From out of the ashes I leap! Hiyah! I challenge thee!
Defeat line: With honor I admit defeat!
Post-battle line: I must refine the art of concealment. I bid thee farewell.
Rebattle line: From out of the ashes I leap! Hiyah! I challenge thee!

Intro line: Thanks for finding me! But we still have to battle!
Defeat line: I'll use my ninjutsu on you… “VOLCANIC ASH SWIRL CLOAK”! / …What? It's already over?
Post-battle line: You know what's crummy about hiding? It's lonely if no one comes along.

Intro line: TORI: Both of us, we collect ashes. We battle POKéMON, too.
Defeat line: TORI: We lost… It's boring, so I'm going to get some more ashes.
Post-battle line: TORI: How much ash do we have? Enough for a WHITE FLUTE, I hope.

Intro line: The warmth here is making me drowsy. Battle with me so I can stay awake.
Defeat line: This is a dream. I'm sure of it…
Post-battle line: Losing burns me up… I'm just going to sleep right here! Zzz!

Intro line: Pfft, with these wings I can flick you away!
Defeat line: A… What?
Post-battle line: I don't know what to say when I get beaten so easily…

Intro line: Were you maybe in the middle of gathering volcanic ashes?
Defeat line: Ehehe. We got beaten cleanly.
Post-battle line: I ought to hide under the ashes, too.

Intro line: Y-you want to battle with me? Even though I just caught my POKéMON?
Defeat line: Y-you're all happy to win? Even though it's only me?
Post-battle line: Oh, so now you want to say a word to the loser? / Aren't you just the coolest? Humph!

Intro line: Not many TRAINERS have made it this far.
Defeat line: That must mean you're tough, too…
Post-battle line: You've beaten the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION? That's too much!

Intro line: Consider yourself lucky to be battling me!
Defeat line: This isn't right! I can't lose!
Post-battle line: It's a miracle that you beat me. You can brag about it.

Intro line: You've been slugging through the TRICK HOUSE challenge, too.
Defeat line: I see… You possess an extraordinary style.
Post-battle line: Seeing someone like you should please the TRICK MASTER.

Intro line: Waaah! I've been found! …Huh?
Defeat line: Oh, you're not my mom.
Post-battle line: I'm in trouble with my mom, so I ran. Keep it a secret where I am!

Intro line: What on earth would compel you to come here? You must be curious!
Defeat line: Not just curious, but also strong…
Post-battle line: The man next door… / He says he's just sightseeing, but I don't know about that.
Rebattle line: What on earth would compel you to come back? You must really be curious!

Defeat line: You and your POKéMON… How hot your spirits burn! / The all-consuming heat overwhelms. / It's no surprise that my icy skills failed to harm you.

Intro line: I used to catch colds all the time as a kid, but I became totally fit after I started swimming.
Defeat line: I crave more power…
Post-battle line: TRAINERS travel the fields and mountains, so they must be fit, too.

Intro line: I try not to swim where the currents are too strong.
Defeat line: Oh, please, no!
Post-battle line: If I get swept away, I'll lose all my sense of place…

Intro line: Win or lose, you'll never know until you try!
Defeat line: Waah! I sank in defeat!
Post-battle line: I never battle when I know I'll win. I like to battle at the razor's edge of victory and defeat!

Intro line: I contemplate POKéMON 24 hours a day. How could you possibly beat me?
Defeat line: I lose. I will concede defeat.
Post-battle line: Urggh… You're a POKéMON fanatic, aren't you? / You must contemplate POKéMON 24 hours a day, don't you?

Intro line: Now where could my wife have gone? I'm always with her. I wonder if I can win on my own.
Defeat line: Ah, I see that I couldn't manage to win on my own after all.
Post-battle line: My wife must be looking for me. I'd best go find her right away.

Intro line: I liked training here by myself. It's awful that all these people came!
Defeat line: Okay! I won't complain about other people being here.
Post-battle line: I suppose I can partner up with that old man and challenge that other team.

Intro line: Someone's been watching me intently. Was it you?
Defeat line: Wow! That's pretty strong, all right!
Post-battle line: I can't shake this feeling that someone's watching me. / I can't concentrate!

Intro line: I'm always with my husband, but I can win even without him.
Defeat line: Oh, I guess I wasn't good enough.
Post-battle line: That young man over there looks just like my husband when he was young. / He's making me blush!

Defeat line: Wow! That's great! {PLAYER}{KUN}, you're pretty good!
Wow! That's great! {PLAYER}{KUN}, you're pretty good!
Wow! That's great! {PLAYER}{KUN}, you're pretty good!
Huh, {PLAYER}, you're not too shabby.
Huh, {PLAYER}, you're not too shabby.
Huh, {PLAYER}, you're not too shabby.

Intro line: Did you feel the tug of our soul-soothing fragrance?
Defeat line: You weren't led astray by our aroma…
Post-battle line: Aromatherapy is a form of mental healing that works with fragrances.

Intro line: AMY: I'm AMY. And this is my little sister LIV. We battle together!
Defeat line: AMY: Uh-oh, we lost.
Post-battle line: AMY: You have to think about all kinds of things when you're battling against two TRAINERS.
Rebattle line: AMY: I'm AMY. And this is my little sister LIV. We battle together!

Intro line: Gah! My fishing line's all snarled up! I'm getting frustrated and mean! That's it! Battle me!
Defeat line: Gah! Lost it! I'm even more annoyed now!
Post-battle line: Gah, I'm still boiling mad… Grrrrr…

Intro line: My POKéMON is delightfully adorable! Don't be shy--I'll show you!
Defeat line: Oh, my gosh! My darling POKéMON!
Post-battle line: My delightful POKéMON looks darling even when it's fainted!
Rebattle line: Hi, you! My delightfully adorable POKéMON has become more darling!

Intro line: Did my guitar's wailing draw you in?
Defeat line: My one-man show is ruined…
Post-battle line: I was playing my guitar where few people were around, but a lot of fans have gathered. / Heh, maybe I should turn pro.

Intro line: Whoa! How'd you get into a space this small?
Defeat line: Whoa! The kid can rock!
Post-battle line: Do you like cramped quarters like this?

Intro line: This sort of distance… You should just swim it!
Defeat line: Oh, that's good going!
Post-battle line: Oh, I understand where you're coming from now. / If I had a POKéMON that trusty, I'd want to SURF on it, too!

Intro line: Watch where you're going! We're going to crash!
Defeat line: Groan…
Post-battle line: I'm a poor swimmer so I was practicing… Sorry for almost crashing into you.

Intro line: As promised, we've come for the rocket fuel!
Defeat line: Ran out of fuel…
Post-battle line: Don't think you're on a roll just because you've beaten me!

Intro line: We gave you fair warning! There's nothing sneaky about us!
Defeat line: Grrr… We should've used sneaky treachery…
Post-battle line: Okay, I get it already! The next time, we'll come unannounced.

Intro line: The rocket fuel the SPACE CENTER has in storage--that's what we're after. / We mean to take every last bit of it!
Defeat line: Please, can you spare some fuel? Even a chintzy cup will do!
Post-battle line: What are we going to do with the rocket fuel? / How would I know? Ask our leader upstairs!

Defeat line: Ack! Ack! Aaack!

Intro line: I keep coming back to this same place!
Defeat line: I'm already having trouble, and then you have to beat me? It's not fair!
Post-battle line: It's full of doors here! It's too small and dark in here! Help!

Intro line: I don't know what's going on here. I'm starting to feel sad…
Defeat line: You… You're awful!
Post-battle line: I know I'm weak! And, I have no sense of direction!

Intro line: I don't get it. What would anyone want with a house this bizarre?
Defeat line: I don't get it. How did I lose?
Post-battle line: I don't get it. How many traps are in this house? / You may be the one to solve that.

Intro line: My POKéMON rule! Check them out!
Defeat line: Ouch! A scrape! I have to put on a bandage!
Post-battle line: Bandages are signs of toughness! I've got another one!

Intro line: My BUG POKéMON are tough! Let's battle!
Defeat line: I lost! I thought I had you!
Post-battle line: BUG POKéMON evolve quickly. So they get strong quickly, too.

Intro line: We learn all sorts of things at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL. / I want to test things out for real!
Defeat line: I slacked off in school… That's why I lost.
Post-battle line: I'll have to redo some courses at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL. If I don't, ROXANNE will be steamed.
Rebattle line: I've been studying seriously at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL. I won't lose like I did last time.

Intro line: If the tunnel doesn't go through, then I'll just go over the top.
Defeat line: Gasp… Gasp… Losing made me tired…
Post-battle line: It's no big deal if there's no tunnel. To a HIKER, mountains are roads!

Intro line: Let me teach you how strong my adorable POKéMON is!
Defeat line: You're a notch above me…
Post-battle line: POKéMON that possess cuteness and power, that's ideal, I think.

Intro line: I study at school, and I study on the way home, too!
Defeat line: I'm in shock--I lost?
Post-battle line: Awww, I'll never become an elegant TRAINER like ROXANNE this way!
Rebattle line: I studied a whole lot since I saw you. You must see my achievements!

Intro line: Just so you know, I've never once been bested by anyone at anything.
Defeat line: Oh, my goodness. This is a new experience for me.
Post-battle line: My life of luxury affords me all that I could possibly desire. / However, when it comes to POKéMON, my wealth has no meaning.

Intro line: When you lay your eyes on my POKéMON's gorgeous fur, their beauty will render you helpless!
Defeat line: Oh, baby, say it isn't so!
Post-battle line: Oh, no, no, no! You've mussed up my POKéMON's fur! You've ruined my hairdo, too! I'll have to call my stylist now!

Intro line: We'll rock you hard!
Defeat line: Aiyiyi! No contest at all!
Post-battle line: I should try different POKéMON types, that's what I ought to do.

Intro line: It's a dead end up here. I'm bored, so can we battle?
Defeat line: That was fun even though I lost.
Post-battle line: Want to stay here and keep me company?

Defeat line: Awaaaah! A kid beat me!
Post-battle line: Oh, man, what a disaster… The BOSS is going to be furious…

Defeat line: What?! I lost, too!
Post-battle line: Now what? If we don't get the parts, we're in for it! / Arrgh, I didn't count on being meddled with by some meddling kid!

Intro line: The thought that I'm getting closer to the POKéMON LEAGUE… / I'm getting stage fright…
Defeat line: I couldn't do a thing…
Post-battle line: The POKéMON LEAGUE became distant again… What a letdown…

Intro line: To win your way through the POKéMON LEAGUE, you need the trust of your POKéMON.
Defeat line: Your relationship is based on solid trust.
Post-battle line: By being together all the time, trust grows between POKéMON and TRAINERS.

Intro line: This isn't the goal. It's only a place on the way to the POKéMON LEAGUE.
Defeat line: That's the way!
Post-battle line: You'll do fine, for sure! Your POKéMON are all eager to go!

Intro line: My POKéMON are cosmically awe inspiring!
Defeat line: I've never met anyone like you before.
Post-battle line: Even outside of battle, I sense incredible power emanating from you and your POKéMON.

Intro line: Okay, no need to get your back up! Relax, let's take it easy!
Defeat line: Whoa! Wonderful!
Post-battle line: Sure, this is VICTORY ROAD. / But it's not all that different from the path you've taken so far. / Try to enjoy things the rest of the way!

Intro line: This is my first triathlon. I'm all tense and nervous!
Defeat line: Wroooaaar! I failed to win!
Post-battle line: If I'm all tensed up, I won't be able to give it my all.

Intro line: I'm in the middle of a triathlon, but, sure, why don't we battle?
Defeat line: I was sure I'd win!
Post-battle line: Do you know what's the greatest thing about triathlons? / Testing the limits of your own strength and endurance against Mother Nature!

Intro line: Say hey, hey! Let's get on with it!
Defeat line: Beat, I'm beaten. That's it, done!
Post-battle line: There's nothing for a loser. Time for me to beat it home.

Intro line: What's the hurry? Let's take it slow and easy.
Defeat line: Oh, my. I wanted to relax a little more…
Post-battle line: Don't you hate making mistakes when you're in a rush? / That's why I try to take things slowly.

Intro line: Surfing isn't as easy as it seems, isn't that right?
Defeat line: Winning sure isn't easy.
Post-battle line: You have your sights on the POKéMON LEAGUE? Keep at it!

Intro line: What a surprise! I didn't expect to see a TRAINER out in the sea. / I think we should battle!
Defeat line: This kid's awfully tough…
Post-battle line: Your eyes have that look of someone who's experienced harsh challenges and won. It suits you well!

Intro line: In the deep blue sea, my shattered blue heart finds comfort among waves.
Defeat line: Like the vast blue sea, the world of POKéMON spans depths beyond belief.
Post-battle line: The world's children dream of one day becoming the POKéMON CHAMPION.

Intro line: Floating on the open sea like this… It's peaceful.
Defeat line: I needed to be a little less peaceful!
Post-battle line: Swimming and battling like this… I'm one happy guy…

Intro line: Who are you? Where did you come in from?
Defeat line: Lost it…
Post-battle line: I can't find the way out! / I'm not afraid. Don't get me wrong!

Intro line: Who are you? Where do you think you're going?
Defeat line: I failed to win!
Post-battle line: My partner forgot the map in that submarine! / How's that for being useless?

Intro line: I'll show you the sublime techniques I learned from our LEADER JUAN!
Defeat line: Please forgive me, JUAN…
Post-battle line: Watch what happens if you crack all the floor tiles.

Intro line: You came all the way here, but you won't get to see JUAN. / Not if you lose to me, you won't!
Defeat line: You're strong! I was fooled by your cute looks!
Post-battle line: You might be good enough to avoid being wiped out in one hit by JUAN.

Intro line: Giggle… Your grim look is so charming.
Defeat line: Oh, dear. I went much too easy on you.
Post-battle line: You couldn't lay a finger on JUAN, I'm sure. Giggle…

Intro line: I should teach you how harsh battles can be.
Defeat line: Oh. You're strong.
Post-battle line: I'll tell you something good. / If you want to reach JUAN, you need to walk on each floor tile once.

Intro line: The POKéMON GYM of the highest level in the HOENN region… / That's the SOOTOPOLIS GYM.
Defeat line: What a high level you are!
Post-battle line: Rather than being satisfied by being in a strong GYM, I imagine training in other places will make you stronger. But above all, it looks more fun.

Intro line: I train my POKéMON together with JUAN. / Don't think I'm a pushover.
Defeat line: I was beaten…
Post-battle line: I think you have potential. Why don't you stay and train with us?

Intro line: A graceful glide across the ice while crossing no lines… / A TRAINER putting on that performance would be elegantly beautiful!
Defeat line: Well, excuse me?!
Post-battle line: This is really obvious, but how strong you are as a TRAINER has nothing to do with how young or old you are.

Intro line: When I'm with my POKéMON, the time flies by before you can say, “Oops!”
Defeat line: Oops!
Post-battle line: I wish I could forget about lost causes before I can manage an “Oops!”

Intro line: I can battle with really rare POKéMON if you'd like.
Defeat line: Oh, there now! Did you have a good look at my POKéMON?
Post-battle line: I came to this GYM because JUAN praised me for my darling POKéMON. / Oh, if only I'd met JUAN years ago when I was younger…

Intro line: The sight of JUAN conducting a battle… / The very beauty of it compelled me to become a TRAINER.
Defeat line: You battled with more beauty than I could muster…
Post-battle line: The grace you bring to battle is fabulous. / Oh… I'm so fortunate to have found POKéMON.

Intro line: Why keep it a secret? I'm the WATER POKéMON expert! / Huh? You don't know me?
Defeat line: I thought I wasn't too bad, if I may say so, but I guess not… Bleah…
Post-battle line: I got too into fishing. I forgot I had to raise my POKéMON…

Intro line: Leaving footprints in the sand is so fun!
Defeat line: Waah! I got sand in my runners! They're all gritty!
Post-battle line: I want to leave my footprints in the sand everywhere, but they disappear quickly…

Intro line: Should I… Or shouldn't I? / Okay, sure, I will battle!
Defeat line: I shouldn't have battled…
Post-battle line: If you're faced with a decision and you let someone else choose for you, you will regret it, however things turn out.
Rebattle line: Come on, battle with me!

Intro line: Oh, sure, I'll accept your challenge. I have a lot of money.
Defeat line: Why couldn't I win?
Post-battle line: There are some things money can't buy. That's POKéMON…
Rebattle line: After I lost to you, I learned a bunch of things about POKéMON.

Intro line: We must have been fated to meet. May I ask you for a battle?
Defeat line: Oh, my!
Post-battle line: “Hello” is the beginning of “good-bye.” I hope we meet again.
Rebattle line: Hello, we meet again. May I ask you for a battle?

Intro line: GINA: Okay, let's battle with our POKéMON!
Defeat line: GINA: Losing upsets me!
Post-battle line: GINA: You are strong! We have to train lots more!

Intro line: I fished up a tough-looking POKéMON! / It has this magical quality to it! It surely looks tough, yes it does!
Defeat line: What the…
Post-battle line: Hey, MAGIKARP, you sure don't live up to your name, do you?

Intro line: When I heard there was a strange house, I had to check it out.
Defeat line: I've discovered a tough TRAINER!
Post-battle line: I'm sure having a good time checking this place out. / It's a challenge I've found worth repeating!

Intro line: Maybe I could get my BIRD POKéMON to fly over the wall…
Defeat line: Gwaaah! I blew it!
Post-battle line: Ehehehe… I guess I lost because I was trying to cheat.

Intro line: I'm getting dizzy from these rotating doors…
Defeat line: Everything's spinning around and around. I can't take this anymore…
Post-battle line: You don't seem to be affected at all. Or do you have your poker face on?

Intro line: Let me ask you. Did you know? Ah, I should not be so coy. / It was I who taught WALLACE everything there is to know about POKéMON. / Once, I had given up my position as the GYM LEADER. / In my place, I had entrusted WALLACE with the GYM. / However, a compelling reason arose for me to make a comeback. / Ah, but enough chatter. Let us begin our match, shall we? / Please, you shall bear witness to our artistry. / A grand illusion of water sculpted by POKéMON and myself!
Defeat line: Ahahaha, excellent! Very well, you are the winner. / From you, I sense the brilliant shine of skill that will overcome all. / However, compared with me or even WALLACE, you are lacking in elegance. / Perhaps I should make you a loan of my outfit? / … … … … … … … … … … … … / Hahaha, I merely jest! / Rather than my clothes, I shall reward you with this, the RAIN BADGE!
Post-battle line: The TRAINERS who have gathered all the GYM BADGES of HOENN should make way to the ultimate destination. / The POKéMON LEAGUE. / Travel to the easternmost reaches of HOENN, to the island EVER GRANDE. / There, you shall find the POKéMON LEAGUE.
Rebattle line: JUAN: Ah, this GYM had returned to its usual state of serenity… / But our young typhoon has returned to put us to the test again! / Well, my friend, most certainly! / I shall be delighted to dance with you as often as you wish!
